notes.title: Veil of Dust is now launched to V1!
notes.content:
Today's the big day: Veil of Dust is now launched to V1!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40270494/e45f461a78f587473c238d96dbf017cf8901e8e3.png[/img]
Four new romances - for a combined extra replay of around 20 hours - and a variety of other game enhancements await you with the full release update.

We hope you have as much fun playing these new story arcs as we had adding them to the game.

Thank you so much for your continued support. This has been a labor of love: over three years of effort, with thousands of hours of work on nights, weekends, and days off. Having the motivation to complete this massive project is helped each time we hear that we've touched someone's life in some way. Please continue to let us know (through Steam, Discord, etc) what you think of the game, we love to hear from you!

- Elle & Mike

notes.title: Shane protagonist / Town addition update now live and ready to play!
notes.content:
Hello! 
The update we mentioned previously is a-go! This brings us up to 2/3 of our full game and such, we're raising the price to $11.99 to be in-line with the amount of content. (The final price will be $15). Go ahead and give it a download, we'd love to hear what you think of the new content! Thanks so much for your support!

[b]Feature List:[/b]
Playable Shane:
Shane as a playable character
Storyline and visual variations for Shane
Town of La Grande and 14+ inhabitants
Two small arcs for ‘friend’ characters for Shane
New melee fighting weapon for Shane
1 Romance Storyline for Shane
2 teaser arcs for Shane’s other romances

Around the homestead: 
Cows and Chickens
Furniture
The ability to make dyes and dye furniture
Decorations for walls and tables
3 additional crops
Many new recipes

QOL: 
Set quick-equip items
Sort Inventory
Keybinding
Better upgrades menu

-Elle

notes.title: Dev log: 8/24/22 - Town added, Shane as a playable character, house decoration
notes.content:
For those of you that don't know, our next big release is planned for the end of November. We just thought we'd make a post to update everyone on our progress so far. So far, we've implemented the following:
[list]
[*] The town of La Grande setting is set up, including interiors and exteriors
[*] Shane is now a playable character
[*] House Decoration including wall and surface decorations, furniture, and custom colors for dying certain objects.
[*] There are now multiple save slots
[*] A new UX for selecting upgrades to the homestead
[*] Additional things that were a lot of work but would be boring to read about
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40270494/6c2525337ad2cd4d54431cb7e1bebe591a5e3066.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40270494/33c165806fba8fc1d9b80cdde84e1b669ffd834b.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40270494/004f21e09cba17fc416c91d066ee28ba6959310b.png[/img]

Still on the docket for development for the November Release:
[list]
[*] A complete romance arc for Shane with Sylvia Wagner, daughter of the Lutheran Pastor
[*] Teaser romance arcs up to Friend level with Shane's two other romancables 
[*] Multiple townie NPCs
[*] Stock Animals
[/list]

I haven't post too much here, so I'd appreciate it if you could like this post if it was valuable to you so I can make sure to post updates more often. Thanks!

notes.title: Several bug fixes and ability to take screenshots
notes.content:
Several bug fixes and ability to take screenshots

1. Fixed an issue where the game could crash if you went to the river encampment with Shane.
2. Fixed an issue where it was sometimes possible to try to leave the house, and instead walk around in the dark space without going to the homestead.
3. Fixed an issue where two cutscenes would incorrectly trigger on the same night
4. Fixed a rare issue where pressing the keys in a very certain combination under specific circumstances could cause a crash when crafting.
5. Adds the ability to take Steam screenshots.

notes.title: June 24 Fixes
notes.content:
Thanks to everyone for playing our game on the first day and submitting reports to us! For all of the number of hours players have put in so far, we're happy to only have seen a handful of items submitted.

The latest build includes the following fixes:

1. Fixes a bug where standing on certain edges of the river-room tent can cause Aine's commentary to run on repeat
2. Fixes a bug where hugging Shane on the edge of a screen can cause a crash
3. Fixes a bug where coordinates from an unfinished cutscene would cause Aine to walk off to unexpected places after subsequent cutscenes, frequently getting stuck
4. Fixes an issue where save files started on the Demo don't have the axe head when starting a new game
5. Fixes an edge-case bug where multiple cutscenes would attempt to run simultaneously, causing a crash
6. Fixes a bug where climbing at certain edges of the screen could cause Aine to get stuck climbing in place.

notes.title: Veil of Dust is now released!
notes.content:
It's launch day, which means Veil of Dust is now live for sale on Steam now! The most helpful thing a fan can do is to buy a copy and review it ASAP. It really helps a small team like ours gain visibility.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1593170/Veil_of_Dust_A_Homesteading_Game/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/1593170/Veil_of_Dust_A_Homesteading_Game/[/url]

Secondarily, we'll take this opportunity to remind you there's going to be an online Launch Party on July 2nd at 10:00am. We'll be doing some streaming, some games, and some general hanging out. Set a reminder now by clicking through this link ([url=https://youtu.be/BQx9Y1b73MI]https://youtu.be/BQx9Y1b73MI[/url]), or simply click through when it's time.

notes.title: Veil of Dust: A Homesteading Game Early Access Preview Stream
notes.content:
We’ve been working hard over here at Calamity Bay Games and are happy to say that most of the story content and features are implemented into the Early Access build. Here’s some of what we’ve finished adding:

[list]
[*] The entire main storyline centered around the siblings
[*] More capabilities for Shane like doing farm chores and buy/selling things in town
[*] An optional starting tutorial
[*] Full NPC relationship functionality
[*] All of Áine’s Romance-ables story arcs up to friendship level
[*] Ability to befriend and obtain one pet
[*] New crafting station upgrades
[*] Three levels of house upgrades, including various furniture
[*] Quality of Life updates like a map and story hint trigger
[/list]

We’ll be doing a preview stream on Sunday, March 13th at 9am EST (international viewers can click through to YouTube for a converted time) and would love if you would join us for chatting and audience participation! You can set up an alert now, or simply click through this link when it’s time: 

[h1][b]Streaming Event on YouTube:[/b][/h1]
Click to set up a reminder
[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=riJttahourg]https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=riJttahourg[/url]

We’re excited to show what we’ve got and hope to see you there!

notes.title: Upcoming streaming event for Veil of Dust: A Homesteading Game
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We're very excited to announce we'll be holding our first streaming event in one week - on Sunday, the 23rd of May at 11:00am PST! As the title suggests, we'll be showing the first 7-ish game days, which we think will give you all a really good idea of the game in its entirety. You'll get to see the daily game loops as well as some of the bigger goals and pursuits that the final game will afford. 

[previewyoutube=YDRtsmXvUEw;full][/previewyoutube]

You'll also get to know the characters and start to understand their conflicting worldviews as they grapple with the much more pressing appearance of a magical threat. 

[previewyoutube=nZwpgzs9wnU;full][/previewyoutube]

We'll be answering questions and taking requests on what to see during the stream, but if you want to ask ahead of time and get your questions worked into the plan, [url=https://discord.gg/mhhzZCk9JC]join our discord here[/url] and post in the give-us-feedback channel. The discord is also where you'll get the quickest updates and generally be able to give us feedback and guide development. We'll also be drawing our beta testers from here, so we hope to see you there.

To attend the stream, click the link below to set up a reminder on YouTube to alert you when the event goes live. Alternatively, you could just follow that link after the stream has started.  

[h1][url=http://youtube.com/channel/UCtmxPjBXhqoVsBSCl_djXzQ/live]Stream Link Here[/url][/h1]
(Sunday, the 23rd of May at 11:00am PST)

Hope to see you all there!
- Mike and Elle
